The two observed lock files record the tested Linux runtime. The pip freeze may contain Conda build-time file URLs; do not reinstall it blindly. requirements-runtime.txt normalizes those entries to installed versions and omits the editable mmdet3d source, which setup_wsl.sh installs at a pinned commit. Select the environment prefix through MV2D_ENV_PREFIX and set external paths in config/local.env.sh. Existing environments are checked and reused without upgrade.
